description: This file is a Perl script implementing a minimal Git filter protocol version 2, handling communication between Git and custom filter commands like clean and smudge. It reads and writes packets according to Git's filter protocol, managing capabilities and command execution within the Git filtering process.

methods.name: packet_bin_read
methods.description: Reads a binary packet from STDIN following Git filter protocol, handling packet size and content.

methods.name: packet_txt_read
methods.description: Reads a text line packet, ensuring it ends with LF, utilizing packet_bin_read.

methods.name: packet_bin_write
methods.description: Writes a binary packet to STDOUT following Git protocol, prefixing with size.

methods.name: packet_txt_write
methods.description: Writes a text line packet after appending LF, utilizing packet_bin_write.

methods.name: packet_flush
methods.description: Sends a flush packet to STDOUT to indicate end of current packet sequence.
